title: StockEventCancellationError
description: Error returned when one or more line items cannot be cancelled.

messageKey.description: General message key for the cancellation failure.

message.description: General localized message for the cancellation failure.

stockEventLineItemId.description: Id of the line item that could not be cancelled.

messageKey.description: Message key describing why the line item is blocked.

message.description: Localized message describing why the line item is blocked.

type.description: Type of the blocking transaction, e.g. PHYSICAL_INVENTORY.

occurredDate.description: Occurred date of the blocking transaction.

documentNumber.description: Document number of the blocking transaction, if any.
